COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0), an explicit presentation description (grid orientation), and a separate origin/status field for the same p0/current/n0 are present; binding spans display metadata and access metadata, so scope set to unclear.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to a content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report lists identified content items (color labels) with exact coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content values and separate origin/status metadata for the same named units are both reported, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: The text states how coordinates map to rows/columns and lists structured coordinate groups (blocks) showing presentation organization.
